violations.description: pull_request_target with checkout of PR branch head ref
violations.evidence: pull_request_target trigger checks out github.event.pull_request.head.ref with actions/checkout@v4
violations.recommendation: Avoid using pull_request_target with head.ref checkout, or switch to pull_request.

violations.description: Untrusted github.event event fields interpolated directly into shell run script
violations.evidence: github.event.pull_request.title and user.login are interpolated directly into shell run script.
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct shell interpolation.

violations.description: Hardcoded credential / API key in workflow environment block
violations.evidence: API_KEY assigned a hardcoded string literal in env block
violations.recommendation: Store credentials in GitHub Secrets and reference them via secrets.API_KEY.

violations.description: Missing permissions block in GitHub Actions workflow
violations.evidence: Workflow auto-label.yml has no top-level or job-level permissions block.
violations.recommendation: Add a restrictive permissions block (e.g. contents: read) to all jobs or workflows.
